article.title: Production of witnesses without summons.
article.content:
1AProduction of witnesses without summons.

Order 16, Rule 1A
A Subject to the provisions of sub-rule (3) of rule 1, any party to the suit may, without applying for summons under rule 1, bring any witness to give evidence or to produce documents.]

3 Subs. by Act 104 of 1976, s. 66, for rule 1A (w.e.f. 1-2-1977).
